column1: # Generic Candidate build bases. These are selected for every profile and are
# maintained here instead of being discovered from one Volcano checkout.
# The three Go builders cover the maintained stable Volcano v1.12-v1.15 lines.
# busybox:1.24 is schema-1 and rejected by Docker 29/containerd 2.1.
# Transitive runtime images used by the imported Kubernetes E2E framework.
# uses 2.59/1.37.0-1. Keep exact tags because the Candidate selects them.
# Volcano v1.13.0 used a Bitnami tag which is no longer published. v1.13.1
# switched to the equivalent upstream Ray image; retain the old local name.
# E2E_FULL|TYPE. FULL runs every entry separately; upstream ALL remains unchanged.
